tools.name: get_brand_facts
tools.description: Every verified fact about Rankera: what it is, pricing, what is included, policies and what not to state. Use this before describing Rankera.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Rankera plans and prices, and what each includes.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: What Rankera offers (channels, features or services), each with a one-line description.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search every page on rankera.ai by keywords. Returns titles, URLs, markdown URLs and descriptions; read a result with get_page.

tools.name: ask_question
tools.description: Answer a plain-language question about Rankera from its verified facts and its own pages (the same answer as fetching rankera.ai/{question-with-hyphens}). Returns markdown with the source page.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: The clean markdown text of any published page on rankera.ai.
